scientific_integrity: Analytically proved local threshold for the limiting neutral voter diffusion; integer interval certificate replayable; no claim of independent validation or global minimizer.
scientific_limitations: Continuum neutral diffusion; not an assertion for fixed finite electorate sizes.

Historical-priority risk remains for earlier first-passage and restart literature.
title: A unique critical magnetization and a certified linear restart-onset coefficient for voter consensus
